        for j in range(w):
            assert grid[sr+i][sc+j] != 1, (sr+i,sc+j,grid[sr+i][sc+j])
            assert out[dr+i][dc+j] == 1, (dr+i,dc+j,out[dr+i][dc+j])
            out[dr+i][dc+j]=grid[sr+i][sc+j]
